capabilities: Display one animated betta fish over the Obsidian workspace
Map leading graph color groups to the fish's body, fins, and patterns
Open a status and hide menu on click and drag the fish anywhere
Save monthly growth records with note, link, and color-group statistics
Configure size, speed, opacity, visibility, and manual color-group rules
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Graph color groups are read from .obsidian/graph.json because no stable public API exists, with manual rules (e.g. path:Development, tag:#TRPG) as fallback.
problem: Obsidian has no ambient, decorative way to see how the vault's color-group structure changes as notes and links evolve.
summary: Animated betta fish that swims over the workspace, with body, fin, and pattern colors derived from the vault's graph color groups.
